basic_details.job_title: AFT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Tribunal Master/Stenographer, Accounts Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench, New Delhi, is filling 10 posts on deputation basis for a period of three years. The posts are Financial Adviser and Chief Accounts Officer (1), Deputy Controller of Accounts (1), Private Secretary (1), Tribunal Master/Stenographer Grade-I (4), Accounts Officer (2) and Junior Accounts Officer (1). The posts are open to serving officers only. An eligible officer's application in the prescribed pro forma (Annexure-I) may be forwarded by the Department to the Principal Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench, West Block-VIII, Sector-I, R.K. Pur

important_instructions: Applications received without supporting documents, photograph, signature or found incomplete, in any manner, shall be summarily rejected. Candidates who have already applied against Vacancy Circular No 2(17)/2013/Rect/AFT/PB/Adm-I dated 14.11.2025, and whose application was received through proper channel (Cadre Controlling Authority) duly completed in all respects, need not apply again. The office is not yet enlisted in the Directorate of Estate for allotment of General Pool Residential Accommodation. The Principal Registrar of the Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench reserves the right to cancel/vary the vacancies, without assigning any reasons thereof. The information in the Curriculum Vitae, supported by documents on Essential Qualification/Work Experience, will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. In Annexure-I, Pay Band and Grade Pay granted under ACP/MACP should not be shown as the regular pay; only the pay scale of the post held on regular basis is to be mentioned, with ACP/MACP details shown separately. By certifying the application, the employer confirms that the officer, if selected, will be relieved immediately.

content_sections.heading: About AFT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench, functions from West Block-8, Sector-1, R.K. Puram, New Delhi (Tel: 011-26105366, Fax: 011-26105361, as printed on the letterhead). This circular was issued by Sunil Kumar Sharma, Deputy Registrar, and was circulated to the Supreme Court of India, all High Courts, the Central Administrative Tribunal, the Controller General of Defence Accounts, the Controller General of Accounts, the Comptroller and Auditor General of India, Delhi universities, the Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha Secretariats and other offices so that eligible officers can apply.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed pro forma, Annexure-I (Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma), which is attached to the circular. The application of the eligible officer, who can be spared in the event of his/her selection, may be forwarded by the Department to this address: The Principal Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench, West Block-VIII, Sector-I, R.K. Puram, New Delhi - 110 066 Fill in Annexure-I, stating the post applied for, and paste a latest photograph duly self-attested in the box provided. Give the details asked in the form: date of birth, mobile number, e-mail ID, date of entry into service, date of retirement, educational qualifications, essential and desirable qualifications and experience, and employment details in chronological order (a separate signed sheet may be attached if space is insufficient). Sign the declaration that the information is correct and that the Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee. Get the "Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority" completed and countersigned with seal. Attach photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years, duly attested, and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate. The Department may forward the complete application to the Principal Registrar at the address above by 28 December 2026. The notice does not mention a postal mode or any wording for the envelope. Applications sent by candidates directly are not described in the circular; the route given is through the Department.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed pro forma (Annexure-I) with a latest photograph duly self-attested. Photocopies of the Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years, duly attested by the Competent Authority (the employer's certificate in Annexure-I refers to the CR Dossier in original or photocopies of the ACRs for the last 5 years attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Govt. of India or above). Vigilance Clearance Certificate. For officers already on deputation: the application should be forwarded by the parent cadre/Department along with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and integrity certificate. Where the applicant's organisation does not follow the Central Government pay scale: the latest salary slip showing basic pay with scale of pay and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances (with break-up) and total emoluments may be enclosed. Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority, countersigned with seal: no vigilance or disciplinary case pending/contemplated, integrity certified, ACRs enclosed, and no major/minor penalty in the last 10 years or a list of such penalties enclosed.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 posts: Financial Adviser and Chief Accounts Officer (1), Deputy Controller of Accounts (1), Private Secretary (1), Tribunal Master/Stenographer Grade-I (4), Accounts Officer (2) and Junior Accounts Officer (1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for AFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application may be forwarded by the Department to the Principal Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench, New Delhi by 28 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the AFT deputation posts?
faq.answer: Serving officers only: officers of the organised Accounts Cadre of the Central Government for the accounts posts, and Stenographers of Central/State Government, courts or statutory/autonomous bodies with pensionary benefits for Private Secretary and Tribunal Master/Stenographer Grade-I, holding analogous posts or the prescribed regular service.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years, with a residual service of four years on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary in AFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs 35400-112400) for Tribunal Master/Stenographer Grade-I and Junior Accounts Officer to Level-13 (Rs 123100-215900) for Financial Adviser and Chief Accounts Officer, governed by DoP&T O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for AFT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I pro forma, attach attested ACR photocopies for the last five years and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate, and have the Department forward it to the Principal Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Principal Bench, West Block-VIII, Sector-I, R.K. Puram, New Delhi - 110 066.

faq.question: Q7. For how long is the AFT deputation?
faq.answer: The posts are on deputation basis for a period of three years. Total deputation including an immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation shall not ordinarily exceed five years for Financial Adviser and Chief Accounts Officer and three years for the other posts.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to apply again if I applied against the 2025 circular?
faq.answer: No, if your application against Vacancy Circular dated 14.11.2025 was received through the Cadre Controlling Authority and was complete in all respects, you need not apply again.

faq.question: Q9. Can feeder-grade officers of AFT apply on deputation?
faq.answer: No. Departmental officers in the feeder grade who are in direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation.

faq.question: Q10. Will government accommodation be provided to selected officers?
faq.answer: The circular states that the office is not yet enlisted in the Directorate of Estate for allotment of General Pool Residential Accommodation.
